synopsis: Chapter 7 identifies a Credible Simulation Process associated with prostep ivip and SET Level, dating from 2021 to 2024 [f5216]. It also dates the prostep ivip Simulation Credibility paper to 2024 [f5583]. The glossary corroborates that publication year, identifies the paper as version 8.1, and lists it as related work on the Credible Simulation Process [f14593]. The supplied facts establish this process-and-publication connection but do not describe its application to validating the braking system [f5216, f5583, f14593].
